verdict.rationale: Sardine's docs say its lightweight TIN Verification report is 'ideal for customers looking to perform KYB in bulk.' They also describe ongoing daily sanctions/PEP screening across existing and new customers, and AI agents that auto-clear low-risk matches. Together these give thin, glancing evidence that operations can be applied across many items at once. missing for 10: a documented bulk/batch API or bulk-upload mechanism, dashboard bulk actions (e.g., bulk case resolution or bulk edits), limits and workflow details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
